note: Assumptions for the whole Speech AI course (not measured). Change them only in the authoring brief.
wrong_action_note: a return started or a wrong status given: a second call, a correction and some goodwill
missed_follow_up_note: a promise in a call that nobody acts on: a complaint, a second call, sometimes a lost customer
review_minute_note: a team lead listens to calls at 45 dollars an hour
cpu_server_note: a general-purpose cloud server with 4 vCPUs and 16 GB, on demand (assumption in the range of the large providers' list prices)
ivr_call_compute_note: recognition and voice for one IVR call of about one minute on the CPU server above (assumption, rounded up)
